reviewer_statement: Developer-scoped native R lossless scientific FDataGrid constructor record from frozen Python 1.2: same observed source value array, evaluation grid, declared coordinate order and dataset name. Not skfda.FDataGrid class, backend methods or certified full Python contract.
native_language_semantic_policy: Real native R retained scientific constructor arrays; Python optional backend class identity, attributes, methods, exceptions and estimator equivalence deliberately excluded. Original native R behavior remains default.

case_evidence.description: Frozen public to_skfda_grid(trajectories) validates a common-grid TrajectorySet, imports optional skfda.FDataGrid, then passes unchanged data_matrix, grid_points, coordinate_names and exact source dataset_name.

Bounded native R complete or explicitly missing common-grid trajectory input, nonempty curves/channels and finite increasing time; source optional dependency import and arbitrary NumPy/pandas class coercions not reproduced.

Exact curve-by-time-by-coordinate numerical values, original observation-time grid without resampling, original coordinate order and named dataset, explicit normalized singleton domain-grid and domain_range. Missing samples retained.

Reject invalid native trajectory collections, unsupported strict_source_record types and invalid source geometry; Python ImportError, NumPy warnings, FDataGrid construction errors are not equivalent in native R.
Tagged native R etr_skfda_fdatagrid_scientific_record including source_constructor, normalized source grid, provenance, source indices and explicit backend_object=NULL; not Python skfda.FDataGrid.
Identity-preserving finite-dimensional functional data conversion with no interpolation, smoothing, basis projection, imputation, fitting, outlier detection or changed observations.

independent_review_status: Provisional six-domain developer-authored scientific constructor audit. No independently certified full contract; executable exact-head R/Python qualification pending.
language_specific_limits: No Python FDataGrid class/attribute methods or actual optional backend object.
No qualification of real scikit-fda evaluation, integration, metric functions or backend numerical errors.
